_comment: The feature guides on sheprd.org/features, in the order shown. Each id names its screencast, scripts/screencast/features/ID.json, whose narration is the page's transcript. Run website/tools/features.py after changing this file or a clip.

features.headline:
Talk to your agents.
See their work.
features.dek: Your coding agents in a real chat, beside the terminal. Every file read, edit and test run is a card you can open.
features.description: Run coding agents in native chats beside your terminal, and follow each read, edit and test run.
how: Start a chat
Click the sparkle button in the tab bar for a new agent chat in the current workspace.
Ask for the change
Type what you need and press Return. The agent works in your checkout.
Follow every step
Each read, edit and command shows as a card with its files and output, so nothing happens out of sight.
features.keywords: ACP agent chat claude codex gemini assistant conversation prompt tool calls

features.headline:
Read it
before it ships.
features.dek: Every file an agent touched, beside the code it replaces, with notes that go straight back to the agent.
features.description: Review an agent's changes file by file, leave notes on lines, and mark files viewed.
how: Open Review Changes
Search for it in the command palette. It lists every file with uncommitted changes, or everything since the base branch.
Note what should change
Click a line number, describe the change and add the note. Notes go to the workspace's agent.
Keep track
Mark each file viewed once it looks right, and hide viewed files to see what is left.
features.keywords: diff git code review notes comments uncommitted branch viewed

features.headline:
Everything,
one shortcut away.
features.dek: Workspaces, terminals, agents and every command in one list. Type a few letters, press Return.
features.description: Find any workspace, terminal, agent or command in Sheprd's command palette.
how: Open it
Press Command Shift P (Control Shift P on Linux and Windows).
Type and go
A few letters find a workspace, a terminal, an agent or a command. Return runs it.
Narrow it down
The chips at the top keep only navigation, commands, projects or notes.
features.keywords: search shortcut keyboard actions commands navigation quick open

features.headline:
The web,
beside your terminal.
features.dek: Preview what your agents build and point at what should change, without leaving Sheprd.
features.description: Open web pages in Sheprd tabs and annotate them for your agents.
how: Open a browser tab
Press Command Shift B and type an address.
Preview as you work
Keep the page next to the agent building it, and reload as it changes.
Point at the change
Annotate, then click an element or select text, and describe what should change.
features.keywords: web page preview localhost annotate notes webview url

features.headline:
Make yourself
at home.
features.dek: Dark, light, or somewhere in between. Preview a theme across the whole window before you make it yours.
features.description: See your workspace change as you browse themes, then keep the one you like.
how: Open the theme picker
Search for themes in the command palette, or open Settings, Theme.
See it before you settle
Move through the list and the whole window changes. Try a light theme, then a dark one.
Keep the one you like
Type to filter, then press Return to keep it.
features.keywords: theme colors dark light mode color scheme appearance ghostty
